PS1:crisis-beat.d: Crisis Beat is a 1998 video game for the Sony PlayStation, developed by Japanese studio Soft Machine. It is a beat-em-up style game. The story is set on a cruise liner where terrorists hijack the ship and the player must pick a pair of characters to fight back.

The player character, Slater, joins the titular G-Police in an effort to uncover the truth behind the death of his sister.

PC:sid-meiers-pirates.d: Sid Meier's Pirates! (also known as Sid Meier's Pirates!: Live the Life, or simply Pirates!) is a 2004 strategy, action and adventure video game developed by Firaxis Games. C64:line-of-fire.d: Line of Fire, released as Line of Fire: Bakudan Yarou in Japan, is a 1989 light gun shooter game developed and published by Sega for arcades. It was released with two arcade cabinet versions: a standard upright and a sit-down cockpit, both featuring two positional guns. The cockpit design allows the player(s) to sit down while playing the game, while having two-handed machine guns, controlled by a potentiometer-controlled gun alignment software system. The game follows a two-man commando unit as they try to escape from a terrorist facility after seizing a prototype weapon.

C64:menace.d: Menace is a horizontally scrolling shooter developed by DMA Design and published by Psygnosis. It was released for the Amiga and Atari ST in 1988, and for the Commodore 64 and MS-DOS in 1989. The game is set on the planet of Draconia, where players are tasked with destroying the planet's defence mechanisms in order to kill the harmful creatures. The game was designed by David Jones, and was the first game developed by his company DMA Design.

Android:worlds-of-magic.d: Worlds of Magic is a single-player fantasy turn-based 4X strategy game developed by Wastelands Interactive and published for Microsoft Windows in 2015. In late 2015 it received a PS4 and Xbox One ports under the name Worlds of Magic: Planar Conquest; which has been sometimes described as an improved sequel. In 2016 Worlds of Magic: Planar Conquest was also released for PC, iOS and Android as Planar Conquest. In 2020 Planar Conquest was ported to Nintendo Switch.
